request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: Finds classes whose direct base resolves to the SQLDatabase class defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py, excluding classes in tests/ files. For each, it lists public methods (names not starting with underscore) defined in the class body that SQLDatabase does not itself define.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols base ON base.symbol_id = cb.base_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols m ON m.file_id = s.file_id AND m.qualname LIKE s.name || '.%' JOIN code.symbol_profile sp ON sp.symbol_id = m.symbol_id WHERE base.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND base.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND s.kind = 'class' AND s.file_id NOT LIKE 'tests/%' AND m.kind = 'method' AND sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND m.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols bm JOIN code.symbol_profile bsp ON bsp.symbol_id = bm.symbol_id WHERE bsp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = base.symbol_id AND bm.kind = 'method' AND bm.name = m.name) ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name
